rows: Bind the recovered facade baseline to gate evidence
The passing SwiftCAD facade and CADExchange baselines are reproduced from one clean revision with machine-readable timing and environment manifests
Behavioral matrix passes for every validated Surface3D representation pair, or unsupported pairs are typed and the capability is partial
Complete general intersection and Boolean materialization
Supported producer outputs compose through pcurve generation, face arrangements, region classification, and topology validation
Certify Agent-facing queries and edit identity
Global projection, deterministic tie-breaking, lineage, cache, and stable selection pass adversarial edit-chain tests
Generalize sketch, blend, shell, sweep, pattern, and direct-edit algorithms
Capability envelopes no longer depend on special-case topology
Add external CAD oracles and same-revision gate manifests
STEP/IGES round trips, corpus tests, fuzzing, performance, and all G0-G7 evidence are green on one commit
